content_html: You have some very interesting ideas, and in this type of scenario, it makes perfect sense. However, I am working on a team with 2 other developers. Both of whom are working remotely. What do you suggest for this type of environment?
A remote environment is always going to have more communication challenges. I’d suggest IM with voice so you can pop in and out of conversations at will.

Have you read joelonsoftware’s comment on these type of spaces?

Basically the gist is, if someone comes in with an issue that really only concerns 1 developer, the interruption is happening for everyone.

My task board is around the corner in another office, which makes it kind of annoying when I need to pin up/take down tasks.
I haven’t read that. I think that’s a less important scenario that can be managed.
